endorsements.quote: Implement a policy for managing COI related to AI, such as excluding individuals with significant conflicts from making decisions on the selection of AI tools, while allowing for their contribution in areas where their expertise is essential but their COI does not influence outcomes.

Plan for training sessions for guideline development team members on the use of AI tools, ensuring they understand how to effectively use these technologies in their work and that they understand their limitations.
Conduct a thorough review of the AI‐specific outputs in the guideline by experts in AI, data science, and healthcare to ensure accuracy, relevance, and completeness.

unlisted_practices: Document all processes in which AI tools were used in guideline development to ensure transparency and reproducibility.
Explicitly report in the guideline how AI tools were used, specifying the tools and methodologies employed.
Include AI and data science experts in the guideline development group.
Establish a workflow for how AI-generated outputs will be incorporated into guideline development, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Determine how disagreements regarding AI-based outputs or their interpretations will be resolved.
Validate AI-extracted data and summaries through a documented human validation process, including error rates or agreement metrics.
Disclose and publish AI-related conflicts of interest among guideline group members and how they were managed.
Regularly update conflict of interest declarations to reflect new AI-related interests.
Implement feedback mechanisms to evaluate and continuously improve the impact of AI tools on the guideline development process.
Define criteria for modifying, continuing, or discontinuing AI tools in guideline development based on evaluation evidence.
Delineate AI and human roles in developing guideline recommendations.
Document the prompts used and the roles assigned to AI tools when generating guideline questions or outcomes, and evaluate potential AI bias.
Require disclosure of intellectual property interests in AI technologies that could influence selection of AI tools.
Establish a framework to keep selected AI tools current throughout the guideline development process.

screen.reason: Development of a consensus checklist extension (guideline framework) for integrating and governing artificial intelligence in the health guideline development enterprise.
